# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.55

Changes since version [0.0.54](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.54).

## Added

- **System → Find Script…** searches the `PATH` for PowerShell scripts on Windows and executable `.sh` scripts on Linux and experimental Apple Silicon builds. **Frequently Used** ranks scripts by launch count. Select a script to run it in the current folder, with guided input for recognizable PowerShell parameters and manual argument entry for shell scripts. Windows requires a compatible PowerShell default profile in Windows Terminal. Linux and macOS require Bash or Zsh with VS Code shell integration.

## Improved

- Select the bell in the upper-right corner to copy the activity log directly to the clipboard. File-manager messages are recorded in the log. The bottom status bar displays active progress and its cancellation control.

- `F9` opens Windows Terminal with its default profile. On Linux and in the experimental macOS build, it opens the integrated VS Code terminal with its default profile.
- Folder tabs show their full path in an immediate tooltip styled with the active VS Code theme. The close hint is available in the tab context menu.
- Switching to the Date or Size column by clicking its header puts the newest or largest entries first. Click the same header again to reverse the order.

## Fixed

- The editor used by X-Ray and Quick Diff includes DOMPurify 3.4.17 to address known HTML sanitization vulnerabilities.

## Updating

Update Bitfroest.fs in the VS Code Extensions view on the pre-release channel. Supported packages target Windows x64 and Linux x64. The Apple Silicon package is experimental. macOS has no official support.
